<parameter=code>

def state(frame):
    out={}
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        c=n['color']
        if c in ('N','R','b') and n['pixels']>=12:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            if min(rows)<50:
                cols=[p[1] for p in b]; out[c]=(min(cols),max(cols))
    sq=None
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']>=18:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            if min(rows)<50:
                cols=[p[1] for p in b]; sq=(min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return out, sq
print("before:", state(current_frame))
r = action(['UP'], intent='explore')
print("UP result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','done','level_completed','game_over')})
print("after UP:", state(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
